pages.text: Every scroll recipe has a polarity range. Even with all essences annihilated, nothing is produced if the crucible's polarity falls outside it.$(br2)The HUD's two inner pointers mark the upper and lower limits; the outer pointer must lie between them—adjust in advance when necessary.

pages.title: Changing Polarity Ⅱ
pages.text: In scroll alchemy, mismatched slot reactions also change polarity: the change of a "virtual" target essence manifests as a change to the crucible's polarity.$(br2)Besides tuning polarity through symbiosis or mutual-restraint essence reactions, you can also use deliberately planned failed reactions to adjust it.
